_readme: Curated startups per city. `ats` is one of: greenhouse | lever | ashby. `token` is the company's board slug (the last path segment of their job-board URL, e.g. boards.greenhouse.io/<token>, jobs.lever.co/<token>, jobs.ashbyhq.com/<token>). Run `npm run validate` to test every token against the live APIs. The weekly discovery agent (npm run discover) adds new validated companies automatically; add your own here anytime.
